	function getTrackingMeta() {
		try {

	function getResourceTiming(src) {
		try {
			if (typeof performance === "undefined" || !performance.getEntriesByName) return { state: "unsupported" };
			const entries = performance.getEntriesByName(src);
			const entry = entries[entries.length - 1];
			if (!entry) return { state: "missing" };
			return {
				state: "present",
				duration: Math.round(entry.duration),
				encodedBodySize: entry.encodedBodySize,
				requestStart: Math.round(entry.requestStart),
				responseEnd: Math.round(entry.responseEnd),
				responseStart: Math.round(entry.responseStart),
				responseStatus: typeof entry.responseStatus === "number" ? entry.responseStatus : "unknown",
				transferSize: entry.transferSize
			};
		} catch {
			return { state: "error" };
		}
	}
	function getDiagnosticFetchDiagnostics(src) {
		try {
			if (typeof fetch === "undefined") return Promise.resolve({ state: "unsupported" });
			const controller = typeof AbortController !== "undefined" ? new AbortController() : null;
			let timeoutId;
			const timeout = new Promise((resolve) => {
				timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
					controller?.abort();
					resolve({ state: "timeout" });
				}, 3e3);
			});
			const diagnostics = fetch(src, {
				method: "GET",
				mode: "cors",
				credentials: "omit",
				signal: controller?.signal
			}).then(async (response) => {
				const body = await response.arrayBuffer().catch(() => /* @__PURE__ */ new ArrayBuffer(0));
				clearTimeout(timeoutId);

					state: "present",
					responseStatus: response.status,
					responseType: response.type,
					bodyBytes: body.byteLength,
					xCdn: response.headers.get("x-cdn") || "missing",
					xCache: response.headers.get("x-cache") || "missing",
					xCdnClientIpVersion: response.headers.get("x-cdn-client-ip-version") || "missing",
					xCdnProto: response.headers.get("x-cdn-proto") || "missing",
					xCdnRcode: response.headers.get("x-cdn-rcode") || "missing"

				clearTimeout(timeoutId);
				return { state: "error" };
			});

		} catch {
			return Promise.resolve({ state: "error" });
		}

	async function getLoadFailureDiagnostics(src) {
		const timing = getResourceTiming(src);
		const visibilityState = d.visibilityState || "unknown";
		const readyState = d.readyState || "unknown";
		const diagnosticFetch = typeof timing.responseStatus === "number" && timing.responseStatus >= 400 ? { state: "skipped" } : await getDiagnosticFetchDiagnostics(src);

			"visibilityState=" + visibilityState,
			"readyState=" + readyState,
			"webdriver=" + String(typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator?.webdriver === true),
			"resourceTiming=" + timing.state
		];
		if (timing.state === "present") details.push("duration=" + timing.duration, "requestStart=" + timing.requestStart, "responseStart=" + timing.responseStart, "responseEnd=" + timing.responseEnd, "transferSize=" + timing.transferSize, "encodedBodySize=" + timing.encodedBodySize, "responseStatus=" + timing.responseStatus);
		details.push("diagnosticFetch=" + diagnosticFetch.state);
		if (diagnosticFetch.state === "present") details.push("diagnosticFetchStatus=" + diagnosticFetch.responseStatus, "diagnosticFetchResponseType=" + diagnosticFetch.responseType, "diagnosticFetchBodyBytes=" + diagnosticFetch.bodyBytes, "x-cdn=" + diagnosticFetch.xCdn, "x-cache=" + diagnosticFetch.xCache, "x-cdn-client-ip-version=" + diagnosticFetch.xCdnClientIpVersion, "x-cdn-proto=" + diagnosticFetch.xCdnProto, "x-cdn-rcode=" + diagnosticFetch.xCdnRcode);

	function fireJetError(error, tags) {

	function reportMetric(groupName, metricName) {
		try {
			fetch("/sensorCollect/?action=reportMetrics", {
				method: "POST",
				credentials: "include",
				headers: {
					"content-type": "application/json",

					"x-restli-protocol-version": "2.0.0"
				},
				body: JSON.stringify({
					metrics: [{
						groupName,
						counterMetrics: { [metricName]: 1 }
					}],
					debug: false
				})
			}).catch(() => void 0);
		} catch {}
	}

			});

	const onExecError = (e) => {
		if (execTriggered || isRehydrated()) {
			w.removeEventListener("error", onExecError);
			w.removeEventListener("unhandledrejection", onRejection);

				"como-entry-client-hydration",
				"uncaught:nile-web-client",
				"exec-error"
			]);
		}
	};
	const onRejection = (e) => {
		if (execTriggered || isRehydrated()) {
			w.removeEventListener("error", onExecError);
			w.removeEventListener("unhandledrejection", onRejection);
			return;
		}
		const reason = e.reason;
		if (reason && reason.tags && reason.tags.includes("como-entry-client-hydration")) {
			execTriggered = true;
			reportMetric("nile-web-o11y", "web-client-only-oops");
			fireJetError(reason, reason.tags || ["como-entry-client-hydration", "uncaught:nile-web-client"]);
		}
	};
	w.addEventListener("error", onExecError);
	w.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", onRejection);
